static_traits.name: Lin Lei
static_traits.social_status: 与部分朋友的关系因自卑与比较而紧张；有一位支持性的室友，但尚not yet向其敞开关于羞耻的感受
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without类似心理问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好、合作度高；能够自我Reflection并愿意练习现实检验与重构；对他人评价较为敏感，带有“应该”式自我Demands

basic_info.main_problem: 我对自己的兼职Work感到羞耻，认为自己应该拥有更符合skill且薪酬更高的Work。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of shame are affecting my self-esteem and overall mental health.
growth_experiences: 约一年前完成学业后，Lin Lei在求职中长期not yet能获得全职岗位，由此开始产生明显的羞耻感；每当Seeing job postings或Hearing about friends' career progress时，这些羞耻与Self-denial进一步被激活。
在过去一年里经常与同龄人进行比较，将自身职业进展与他人对照，逐步形成“自己落后、not如人”的体验，导致与部分朋友Relationship tension，并影响日常自我照顾与动力。

core_beliefs: I am a failure/not够有价值
My worth depends on work achievements and income

special_situations.event: 看到与自身skill相关且薪资更高的招聘信息
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not获得与skill匹配且薪酬更高的全职Work，就证明我在浪费潜力并且是失败的
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increases resume submissions, seeks career guidance online; at the same time avoids talking to others about true feelings to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在浪费潜力，我毫without进展

special_situations.event: Hears news of a friend's career promotion or salary increase
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果同龄人走在前面而我have not同等成就，就说明我not如他们
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与这些朋友的互动、Reduced socializing接触；用更多时间刷职位信息与比较他人履历

special_situations.event: Considers seeking feedback from roommates or friends / sharing feelings of shame
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果暴露自己的not足，就会被看not起或被负面评价
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps silent, avoids self-exposure and seeking help, to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会看not起我、会评判我

special_situations.event: 回想完成学业后长期not yet能找到全职Work的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在关键阶段not达成目标，就意味着我永远会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Drives more job-seeking action with self-criticism, but ignores the positive side of the current job to 'spur oneself'

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to have her abilities and worth affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, humiliated, or seen as a failure
defense_goal: 通过追求更“体面”的Work来证明自我价值、缓解without价值感

object_relations.self_representation: 落后且not够成功的人、容易被negate的自我

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on seeking feedback from others or honestly sharing feelings with roommates
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将自身严苛的自我批评与negate投向他人，体验为“do not人会看not起我/会评判我”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和、without评判地Clarification与验证，邀请举具体证据与替代Interpretation；正常化羞耻体验，缓慢探询其担心被评价的具体图景。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about career achievements and 'whether it is meaningful'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tends to discuss experiences with rational analysis, downplaying the expression of shame and vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Slowing the pace, using reflection of feelings and present-experience-oriented questions ('where in your body do you feel it most right now?') to help bring the emotions in the narrative back to the present.

manifestations: 认为自己“在浪费潜力、have not实现任何有意义的成就”
Treats career and income as the core measure of meaning and value
outcomes: Decreased drive与自我照顾受影响

manifestations: 担心被评判而not向室友或朋友敞开羞耻感受
Relationships with some friends strained due to inferiority and comparison
outcomes: The support system has difficulty functioning

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Frequently demanding of oneself with 'should have a more respectable / higher-paying job'
Treats society's / peers' career standards as the sole measure of her own worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 担心被评判而Suppressing expression羞耻与需要
Overly cautious about sharing and seeking help, limiting contact with supporters

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将自身的Self-denial体验解读为“do not人会看not起我”
In social situations, presumes others hold negative views and thus avoids contact

positive_force: Has supportive roommates who can provide emotional and practical support
Has help-seeking motivation and is willing to practice reality testing and restructuring
能识do not并承认当下Work的积极面（支付账单、积累经验）
Continuously submits resumes and proactively seeks career guidance online
negative_force: Frequent social comparison, prone to triggering inferiority and shame
Highly binds self-worth to career achievement and income
心理过滤与negate积极导致自我Reinforcement的失败感
对他人评判的担忧（读心式Anticipation）限制求助

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation与羞耻的Automatic thoughts（如“我在浪费潜力”“我have not任何有意义的成就”）
antecedent: 回想完成学业后not yet获全职Work的经历
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates self-worth with career achievement and income, and engages in frequent social comparison
target_behavior.function: Maintains an illusion of 'spurring on' and control through self-criticism, while avoiding positive evidence to maintain cognitive consistency
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Decreased drive、Declining job satisfaction and performance

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids disclosing feelings to roommates/friends and seeking support
antecedent: 想到与他人谈及羞耻与not足
When advised to seek external feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被评判/羞辱，将内在Self-denial投向他人的Anticipation
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在负面评价以短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension、The support system has difficulty functioning、Loneliness与羞耻维持

target_behavior.behavior: 自我照顾与日常规律下降（如动机not足、例行护理减少）
antecedent: After comparison and feelings of failure are activated
target_behavior.core_reason: 羞耻与Self-denial导致行为激活降低与回避
target_behavior.consequence: Mood and energy decline further, forming a negative cycle
